_meta.title: Bo neo dong Lam Te Duong Ky tu TTL (doi 45-70)
_meta.source: File TTL do Admin tao trong data/ttl/*.ttl (KHONG git-track, xem .gitignore 'data/'). Doc truc tiep bkg:generationOrder, bkg:hasTeacher, rdfs:label@vi tung file bang Read/Grep - KHONG query data/lineage.db, KHONG BFS.
_meta.generation_order_basis: bkg:generationOrder trong TTL la doi Thien Tong TUYET DOI (khong phai doi DILA). Doi chieu Admin 2026-11-07: Dao Man Moc Tran = 68 khop 'doi thu 31 Lam Te' + 37; Nguyen Thieu Sieu Bach = 70.
_meta.chain_integrity: Da xac minh noi bo: moi muc 46..70 co bkg:hasTeacher tro dung ve ex:monk/<slug> cua muc doi truoc lien ke (xem id_ttl/thay_ttl_id) - chuoi TTL lien tuc, khong dut doan, khong ID trung.
_meta.dila_lock_rule: trang_thai=locked CHI khi Admin da xac nhan doi DILA khop voi bkg:generationOrder cua TTL (xem docs/rules/naming-and-identity.md: ten khong bao gio la join key). trang_thai=conflict khi co dila_id nhung doi DILA LECH voi TTL - GHI RO, KHONG dung dila_id de khoa doi. trang_thai=ttl_only khi chua co dila_id xac minh (bao gom truong hop co dila_id nhung chua co canh/quan he de doi chieu doi).
_meta.known_name_variants: Mot so ten_viet trong TTL khac nhe so voi ten trong prompt admin (dau thanh/am dau) do di ban phien am Han-Viet; GHI trong ghi_chu tung muc, KHONG tu sua TTL de khop ten vi ten khong phai join key.
_meta.scope_note: File nay TACH RIENG khoi scripts/anchors_khai_to_dong.json (muc Duong Ky Phuong Hoi doi 45, dila A004146, da khoa trong file do bang BFS qua lineage_edge_consensus). Muc doi 45 o day CHI tham chieu lai trang thai da khoa, KHONG tao lock moi.
_meta.dila_id_format: DILA Person ID, dang A\d+ (xem docs/rules/naming-and-identity.md).
